en: ## Control Flow
zh: ## 控制流

en: The ability to run some code depending on whether a condition is `true` and the ability to run some code repeatedly while a condition is `true` are basic building blocks in most programming languages. The most common constructs that let you control the flow of execution of Rust code are `if` expressions and loops.
zh: 根据条件是否为 `true` 来运行某些代码的能力，以及在条件为 `true` 时重复运行某些代码的能力，是大多数编程语言的基本构建块。在 Rust 中，让你控制代码执行流的最常见构造是 `if` 表达式和循环。

en: ### `if` Expressions
zh: ### `if` 表达式

en: An `if` expression allows you to branch your code depending on conditions. You provide a condition and then state, “If this condition is met, run this block of code. If the condition is not met, do not run this block of code.”
zh: `if` 表达式让你根据条件对代码进行分支。你提供一个条件，然后声明：“如果满足这个条件，就运行这段代码。如果不满足这个条件，就不运行这段代码。”

en: All `if` expressions start with the keyword `if`, followed by a condition. In this case, the condition checks whether or not the variable `number` has a value less than 5. We place the block of code to execute if the condition is `true` immediately after the condition inside curly brackets. Blocks of code associated with the conditions in `if` expressions are sometimes called *arms*, just like the arms in `match` expressions that we discussed in the [“Comparing the Guess to the Secret Number”](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch02-00-guessing-game-tutorial.html#comparing-the-guess-to-the-secret-number) section of Chapter 2.
zh: 所有 `if` 表达式都以关键字 `if` 开头，后跟一个条件。在这个例子中，条件检查变量 `number` 的值是否小于 5。我们把条件为 `true` 时要执行的代码块紧跟在条件之后，放在花括号内。`if` 表达式中与条件关联的代码块有时被称为*分支*（arm），就像我们在第 2 章[“将猜测与秘密数字进行比较”](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch02-00-guessing-game-tutorial.html#comparing-the-guess-to-the-secret-number)一节中讨论的 `match` 表达式中的分支一样。

en: Optionally, we can also include an `else` expression, which we chose to do here, to give the program an alternative block of code to execute should the condition evaluate to `false`. If you don’t provide an `else` expression and the condition is `false`, the program will just skip the `if` block and move on to the next bit of code.
zh: 我们还可以选择包含一个 `else` 表达式——这里我们选择这样做——以便在条件求值为 `false` 时为程序提供另一个要执行的代码块。如果你不提供 `else` 表达式且条件为 `false`，程序会直接跳过 `if` 块，继续执行下一段代码。

en: The expression in the `if` block evaluates to an integer, and the expression in the `else` block evaluates to a string. This won’t work, because variables must have a single type, and Rust needs to know definitively at compile time what type the `number` variable is. Knowing the type of `number` lets the compiler verify the type is valid everywhere we use `number`. Rust wouldn’t be able to do that if the type of `number` was only determined at runtime; the compiler would be more complex and would make fewer guarantees about the code if it had to keep track of multiple hypothetical types for any variable.
zh: `if` 块中的表达式求值为整数，而 `else` 块中的表达式求值为字符串。这行不通，因为变量必须具有单一类型，而且 Rust 需要在编译时明确知道 `number` 变量的类型。知道 `number` 的类型，编译器才能在我们使用 `number` 的每个地方验证类型有效。如果 `number` 的类型只能在运行时确定，Rust 就无法做到这一点；如果编译器必须为任何变量跟踪多个假设类型，它会更复杂，对代码的保证也会更少。

en: ### Repetition with Loops
zh: ### 使用循环重复执行

en: It’s often useful to execute a block of code more than once. For this task, Rust provides several *loops*, which will run through the code inside the loop body to the end and then start immediately back at the beginning. To experiment with loops, let’s make a new project called *loops*.
zh: 多次执行同一个代码块通常很有用。为此，Rust 提供了几种*循环*，它们会运行循环体中的代码直到末尾，然后立即从头开始。为了试验循环，让我们创建一个名为 *loops* 的新项目。

en: Rust has three kinds of loops: `loop`, `while`, and `for`. Let’s try each one.
zh: Rust 有三种循环：`loop`、`while` 和 `for`。让我们逐一尝试。

en: #### Repeating Code with `loop`
zh: #### 使用 `loop` 重复代码

en: The `loop` keyword tells Rust to execute a block of code over and over again either forever or until you explicitly tell it to stop.
zh: `loop` 关键字告诉 Rust 反复执行一个代码块，要么永远执行，要么直到你明确告诉它停止。

en: As an example, change the *src/main.rs* file in your *loops* directory to look like this:
zh: 例如，把 *loops* 目录中的 *src/main.rs* 文件改成这样：

en: Filename: src/main.rs
zh: 文件名：src/main.rs

en: When we run this program, we’ll see `again!` printed over and over continuously until we stop the program manually. Most terminals support the keyboard shortcut ctrl-C to interrupt a program that is stuck in a continual loop. Give it a try:
zh: 当我们运行这个程序时，会看到 `again!` 不断打印出来，直到我们手动停止程序。大多数终端支持键盘快捷键 Ctrl-C 来中断陷入持续循环的程序。试一试：

en:
```console
$ cargo run
   Compiling loops v0.1.0 (file:///projects/loops)
    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.08s
     Running `target/debug/loops`
again!
again!
again!
again!
^Cagain!
```

```console
$ cargo run
   Compiling loops v0.1.0 (file:///projects/loops)
    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.08s
     Running `target/debug/loops`

again!
again!
again!
^Cagain!
```

en: The symbol `^C` represents where you pressed ctrl-C.
zh: 符号 `^C` 表示你按下 Ctrl-C 的位置。

en: You may or may not see the word `again!` printed after the `^C`, depending on where the code was in the loop when it received the interrupt signal.
zh: 你是否会在 `^C` 之后看到打印出 `again!`，可能取决于程序接收到中断信号时循环执行到了哪里。

en: Fortunately, Rust also provides a way to break out of a loop using code. You can place the `break` keyword within the loop to tell the program when to stop executing the loop. Recall that we did this in the guessing game in the [“Quitting After a Correct Guess”](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch02-00-guessing-game-tutorial.html#quitting-after-a-correct-guess) section of Chapter 2 to exit the program when the user won the game by guessing the correct number.
zh: 幸运的是，Rust 也提供了用代码跳出循环的方法。你可以在循环中放置 `break` 关键字，告诉程序何时停止执行循环。回想一下，我们在第 2 章[“猜对后退出”](https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ch02-00-guessing-game-tutorial.html#quitting-after-a-correct-guess)一节的猜数字游戏中就这样做过：当用户猜中正确数字赢得游戏时退出程序。

en: We also used `continue` in the guessing game, which in a loop tells the program to skip over any remaining code in this iteration of the loop and go to the next iteration.
zh: 我们在猜数字游戏中也使用了 `continue`，它在循环中告诉程序跳过本次迭代中剩余的代码，进入下一次迭代。

en: #### Returning Values from Loops
zh: #### 从循环返回值

en: One of the uses of a `loop` is to retry an operation you know might fail, such as checking whether a thread has completed its job. You might also need to pass the result of that operation out of the loop to the rest of your code. To do this, you can add the value you want returned after the `break` expression you use to stop the loop; that value will be returned out of the loop so that you can use it, as shown here:
zh: `loop` 的一个用途是重试你知道可能会失败的操作，例如检查某个线程是否完成了任务。你可能还需要把该操作的结果传出循环，交给代码的其他部分使用。为此，你可以在用于停止循环的 `break` 表达式之后添加想要返回的值；该值会被传出循环供你使用，如下所示：

en: Before the loop, we declare a variable named `counter` and initialize it to `0`. Then, we declare a variable named `result` to hold the value returned from the loop. On every iteration of the loop, we add `1` to the `counter` variable, and then check whether the `counter` is equal to `10`. When it is, we use the `break` keyword with the value `counter * 2`. After the loop, we use a semicolon to end the statement that assigns the value to `result`. Finally, we print the value in `result`, which in this case is `20`.
zh: 在循环之前，我们声明一个名为 `counter` 的变量并初始化为 `0`。然后，我们声明一个名为 `result` 的变量，用来保存从循环返回的值。在循环的每次迭代中，我们给 `counter` 变量加 `1`，然后检查 `counter` 是否等于 `10`。当它等于 10 时，我们使用带值 `counter * 2` 的 `break` 关键字。循环之后，我们用分号结束把值赋给 `result` 的语句。最后，我们打印 `result` 中的值，在这个例子中是 `20`。

en: You can also `return` from inside a loop. While `break` only exits the current loop, `return` always exits the current function.
zh: 你也可以在循环内部使用 `return`。`break` 只退出当前循环，而 `return` 总是退出当前函数。

en: #### Disambiguating with Loop Labels
zh: #### 使用循环标签消除歧义

en: If you have loops within loops, `break` and `continue` apply to the innermost loop at that point. You can optionally specify a *loop label* on a loop that you can then use with `break` or `continue` to specify that those keywords apply to the labeled loop instead of the innermost loop. Loop labels must begin with a single quote. Here’s an example with two nested loops:

en: The outer loop has the label `'counting_up`, and it will count up from 0 to 2. The inner loop without a label counts down from 10 to 9. The first `break` that doesn’t specify a label will exit the inner loop only. The `break 'counting_up;` statement will exit the outer loop. This code prints:
zh: 外层循环带有标签 `'counting_up`，它会从 0 数到 2。内层没有标签的循环从 10 倒数到 9。第一个未指定标签的 `break` 只会退出内层循环。`break 'counting_up;` 语句会退出外层循环。这段代码会打印：

```console
$ cargo run

    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.58s

remaining = 10
remaining = 9
count = 1
remaining = 10
remaining = 9
count = 2
remaining = 10
End count = 2
```

```console
$ cargo run
   Compiling loops v0.1.0 (file:///projects/loops)
    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.58s

count = 0
remaining = 10
remaining = 9
count = 1
remaining = 10
remaining = 9

remaining = 10
```

en: #### Streamlining Conditional Loops with while
zh: #### 用 while 精简条件循环

en: A program will often need to evaluate a condition within a loop. While the condition is `true`, the loop runs. When the condition ceases to be `true`, the program calls `break`, stopping the loop. It’s possible to implement behavior like this using a combination of `loop`, `if`, `else`, and `break`; you could try that now in a program, if you’d like. However, this pattern is so common that Rust has a built-in language construct for it, called a `while` loop. In Listing 3-3, we use `while` to loop the program three times, counting down each time, and then, after the loop, to print a message and exit.
zh: 程序经常需要在循环内评估条件。当条件为 `true` 时，循环运行；当条件不再为 `true` 时，程序调用 `break`，停止循环。你可以用 `loop`、`if`、`else` 和 `break` 的组合实现这种行为；如果愿意，现在就可以在程序中试一试。不过，这种模式非常常见，所以 Rust 为此内置了一种语言构造，称为 `while` 循环。在代码清单 3-3 中，我们使用 `while` 让程序循环三次，每次递减，然后在循环结束后打印一条消息并退出。

en: This construct eliminates a lot of nesting that would be necessary if you used `loop`, `if`, `else`, and `break`, and it’s clearer. While a condition evaluates to `true`, the code runs; otherwise, it exits the loop.
zh: 这种构造消除了使用 `loop`、`if`、`else` 和 `break` 时必要的大量嵌套，而且更清晰。当条件求值为 `true` 时，代码运行；否则，它退出循环。

en: #### Looping Through a Collection with `for`
zh: #### 使用 `for` 遍历集合

en: You can choose to use the `while` construct to loop over the elements of a collection, such as an array. For example, the loop in Listing 3-4 prints each element in the array `a`.
zh: 你可以选择使用 `while` 构造来遍历集合（例如数组）的元素。例如，代码清单 3-4 中的循环会打印数组 `a` 中的每个元素。

en: Here, the code counts up through the elements in the array. It starts at index `0` and then loops until it reaches the final index in the array (that is, when `index < 5` is no longer `true`). Running this code will print every element in the array:
zh: 这里，代码按索引遍历数组中的元素。它从索引 `0` 开始，然后循环直到到达数组的最后一个索引（也就是说，当 `index < 5` 不再为 `true` 时）。运行这段代码会打印数组中的每个元素：

en:
```console
$ cargo run
   Compiling loops v0.1.0 (file:///projects/loops)
    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.32s
     Running `target/debug/loops`
the value is: 10
the value is: 20
the value is: 30
the value is: 40
the value is: 50
```

zh:
```console
$ cargo run
   Compiling loops v0.1.0 (file:///projects/loops)
    Finished `dev` profile [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 0.32s
     Running `target/debug/loops`

the value is: 20
the value is: 30
the value is: 40
the value is: 50
```

en: All five array values appear in the terminal, as expected. Even though `index` will reach a value of `5` at some point, the loop stops executing before trying to fetch a sixth value from the array.
zh: 正如预期，五个数组值都出现在终端中。尽管 `index` 在某个时刻会达到值 `5`，但循环会在尝试从数组中获取第六个值之前停止执行。

en: However, this approach is error-prone; we could cause the program to panic if the index value or test condition is incorrect. For example, if you changed the definition of the `a` array to have four elements but forgot to update the condition to `while index < 4`, the code would panic. It’s also slow, because the compiler adds runtime code to perform the conditional check of whether the index is within the bounds of the array on every iteration through the loop.
zh: 然而，这种方法容易出错；如果索引值或测试条件不正确，我们可能让程序 panic。例如，如果你把数组 `a` 的定义改为四个元素，却忘记把条件更新为 `while index < 4`，代码就会 panic。这种方法也很慢，因为编译器会添加运行时代码，在循环的每次迭代中执行索引是否在数组边界内的条件检查。

en: As a more concise alternative, you can use a `for` loop and execute some code for each item in a collection. A `for` loop looks like the code in Listing 3-5.
zh: 作为一种更简洁的替代方案，你可以使用 `for` 循环，为集合中的每个项执行一些代码。`for` 循环看起来像代码清单 3-5 中的代码。

en: When we run this code, we’ll see the same output as in Listing 3-4. More importantly, we’ve now increased the safety of the code and eliminated the chance of bugs that might result from going beyond the end of the array or not going far enough and missing some items. Machine code generated from `for` loops can be more efficient as well because the index doesn’t need to be compared to the length of the array at every iteration.
zh: 当我们运行这段代码时，会看到与代码清单 3-4 相同的输出。更重要的是，我们现在提高了代码的安全性，消除了因越过数组末尾或没有走够远而漏掉某些项所可能导致 bug 的机会。`for` 循环生成的机器码也可能更高效，因为索引不需要在每次迭代时与数组长度进行比较。

en: Using the `for` loop, you wouldn’t need to remember to change any other code if you changed the number of values in the array, as you would with the method used in Listing 3-4.
zh: 使用 `for` 循环时，如果你改变数组中的值数量，就不需要记住去修改其他代码，而使用代码清单 3-4 中的方法时则需要。

en: The safety and conciseness of `for` loops make them the most commonly used loop construct in Rust. Even in situations in which you want to run some code a certain number of times, as in the countdown example that used a `while` loop in Listing 3-3, most Rustaceans would use a `for` loop. The way to do that would be to use a `Range`, provided by the standard library, which generates all numbers in sequence starting from one number and ending before another number.
zh: `for` 循环的安全性和简洁性使其成为 Rust 中最常用的循环构造。即使在你想让某些代码运行特定次数的情况下，例如代码清单 3-3 中使用 `while` 循环的倒计时示例，大多数 Rustacean 也会使用 `for` 循环。做法是使用标准库提供的 `Range`，它按顺序生成从一个数字开始、到另一个数字之前结束的所有数字。

zh: 你做到了！这一章篇幅不小：你学习了变量、标量与复合数据类型、函数、注释、`if` 表达式和循环！要练习本章讨论的概念，可以尝试构建程序完成以下任务：

zh: 当你准备好继续前进时，我们将讨论一个在其他编程语言中*并不*常见的 Rust 概念：所有权。
